原图目视观察：
绛紫与藕粉墨色、飞白衣纹和持扇人物形成清楚主角，扇与双手靠近躯干，没有大头卡通或花冠。实际人物纵向明显放大，头部高于意图，裙摆下探、飘带右伸；牡丹也比辅景意图大。原图无可见文字、行政界线或模板提示色。

文化与想象边界：
只从文化来源取一般题材、地域和材料线索，不复制来源照片或具体作者作品。新图不继承实拍摄影者署名或许可。来源只支持culturalBasis各项列明范围；器形、装饰、场景与人物均可为原创想象，不给它们编造作者、年代、馆藏或奖项。界面另加AI标识、地名、来源和操作。
用户确认的是市域分拆轮廓方向，不是全部最终画作或行政地图已审定。确认位置为上述confirmationRecordPath，旧预审中的暂停文字由统筹最新明确恢复/扩城授权覆盖。

固定映射：
完整实际方图对应referenceFrame全幅含留边。scale=f/实际宽= f/实际高；在固定frame.x/y绘制f×f，再用原global-mask和evenodd裁切。不先裁去留边，不自动cover、mapFocus、zoom、旋转或移动。subjectCoreInReference仅是生成意图，非实测遮罩结论。
若返回非方形，必须保留实际尺寸并进入映射待核，不拉伸/裁切冒充。

完整实际生成提示词：
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE finished independent SQUARE 1:1 Chinese cultural artwork, full bleed, maximum available native clarity, made for a fixed city-template reference frame. Not a webpage background, poster, map, diagram, sticker, comparison board or multi-panel collage.
Input image 1: the city's outline-reference.png, supplied as COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. The ENTIRE square, including outside margins, is the fixed reference canvas. Preserve its full-square coordinate correspondence. Do not tightly crop the silhouette, zoom it, rotate or reframe. The pale silhouette only tells which parts of the painting will later remain visible.
DO NOT paint the reference silhouette, pale fill, boundary line, blank outside field or any map shape. Instead make a natural complete cultural painting across ALL FOUR EDGES, with the important subject positioned as specified below. The exact administrative edge will be clipped independently by the frontend's original SVG, never by the image model. No green circles, yellow bands, safety markers, outlines, geographic shapes, frames or labels.
One dominant cultural subject; supporting landscape, objects or people stay secondary. Original imagined scenes, buildings, figures and cultural objects are allowed, but not a real-site photograph, collection object, maker's work or historical reconstruction. Never copy a specific artist's composition or craft object.
No text of any kind: no Chinese characters, calligraphy, inscriptions, signatures, seals, logos, numbers, watermarks, QR codes, city labels or UI.
Series family: tangible handmade Chinese art, disciplined large shapes and legible silhouette, visible brush/material, differentiated city palette and arrangement but harmonious neutral fibers. No photorealistic product photography, glossy CGI, generic digital swirls or synthetic gradient wallpaper. Make the artwork fill a square canvas.
City-specific primary request: Heze / Caozhou dough-figurine culture. ONE ORIGINAL unnamed adult female costumed figurine holding a compact folding fan near her torso. Continuous head, torso and flowing hem; calm lively expression. A newly imagined traditional-costume art character, not a named historical figure, opera role, real actor or a maker's existing artwork. Adult-like elegant proportions, NOT a large-headed cartoon fairy. Simple tied hair with one small hairpin, NO flower crown, flower-shaped head, extravagant headdress or copied character system. The fan stays close to chest/waist, not extended far away. One or at most two peony blossoms as small secondary accents around the lower side, never hiding her face or replacing the body. No extra people or tableau.
Composition/framing: A wide, quiet composition of paper and subtle color atmosphere with a modest-size FULL FIGURE at the central point, not a portrait close-up. Use the ENTIRE fixed square reference including its margins. The connected figurine ideally spans x=0.43–0.64, y=0.32–0.67; face around (0.54,0.36), fan/torso recognition core near (0.537,0.50), hem around (0.54,0.64). Keep hands, fan and sleeves compact against the main silhouette so they do not rely on outcropping edges. Do not enlarge to a full-height cover portrait. Most of the canvas is quiet warm paper and restrained brush/petal atmosphere, naturally continuing to all four edges, not a blank map-shaped field. Broad elegant costume folds and legible head/hand/fan mass, avoid lace-like microdetails, too many flowers, dense jewelry or busy embroidered wallpaper. No geographic outline, framing line or template markers.
A medium: Chinese INK PAINTING is unmistakably the main language: expressive brush pressure, charcoal-to-faint five ink tones, flying-white dry brush, wet ink blooms and controlled washes on visible absorbent xuan paper. Restrained color ink is allowed; do not substitute a watercolor-only puddle, glossy material study, paper-cut outline or print texture for true brushwork.
Specific medium/palette: refined expressive Chinese figure INK PAINTING inspired by the grace of a handcrafted figurine. Plum-wine purple and muted lotus-pink ink on warm xuan paper, rich black strokes for hair and broad costume rhythm, pale brushed face and visible pressure variation. Face, folded fan and one sleeve form a calm connected focal group, garment folds rendered with broad economical brushwork, ink bleeds and flying-white rather than photoreal cloth. A restrained peony at the lower-left is a secondary wash. Not a photographic person, porcelain doll or glossy digital portrait. Distinct emotional warmth and wine-colored ink, no mountains or water landscape.
